lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a multi-row grid pattern on the lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectilinear pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient (highlighted top, shadowed bottom) running along the upper third of the flank.
